estimates.notes: Table 2 supplies participant-level post-test means and SDs. Its source quotes reproduce the complete rows in the order n, pre-test M, pre-test SD, post-test M, post-test SD, adjusted post-test M [95% CI]; only the unadjusted post-test cells are used here. Table 1 also prints the zero-order correlation between randomized condition and post-test creativity, retained as the reported r in paper_effect; condition coding is Human-Search = 0 and Human-AI = 1 (PDF p. 5, Section 3.4). The three asterisks are retained in the quote, but Table 1 has no significance legend, so no numerical p-value is assigned to that correlation. No unadjusted difference, two-arm test statistic, or contrast confidence interval is printed. The participant is the analysis unit: Table 2 uses participant counts, and the Figure 1 description identifies individual participant trajectories (PDF p. 5, Section 4). No values were read from the plotted heights, trajectories, box plots, or error bars in Figure 1. The ANCOVA below is a separate analysis of the same sample and outcome, not an independent replication. The printed participant counts and participant-level SDs support the participant se_basis; no unadjusted SE or test is inferred from them.
estimates.primary_override_reason: Rule 2: Neither candidate is designated primary/main, and the abstract and introduction emphasize moderated mediation without selecting an adjusted or unadjusted total-effect specification. Rule 2's no-added-controls fallback therefore selects the unadjusted randomized post-test contrast; the alternative ANCOVA controls for pre-test creativity and demographics. (PDF p. 5 (printed p. 99), Section 4, first ANCOVA sentence (quoted); PDF pp. 1-2 (printed pp. 95-96), Abstract and Introduction, for the absence of a specification preference; PDF p. 6 (printed p. 100), Table 2, unadjusted Post-test columns.: "To test Hypothesis 1, we conducted an ANCOVA examining the effect of AI assistance on post-test creativity scores, controlling for pre-test creativity, age, work experience, gender, and race.")

estimates.notes: ANCOVA controls for pre-test creativity, age, work experience, gender, and race (PDF p. 5, Sections 3.4 and 4). No post-treatment mediator enters this main-effect analysis. The structured arm means, SEs, and treatment-mean CI transcribe the explicit labels in the results prose; Table 2 reverses the adjusted arm means and their CIs, as shown by the complete table rows quoted in the unadjusted record. This conflict is unresolved, and the prose labels are not a verified correction to Table 2. Figure 1 is directionally consistent with the prose, but no numeric values were estimated from it. The source quote for the control mean additionally gives the Human-Search 95% CI [2.95, 3.04]; the main ci_* fields hold only the Human-AI mean interval, not an interval for the difference. The ANCOVA test source also reports partial eta squared, printed as η²p = .166. This is retained here because paper_effect holds the separately printed Cohen's d. The paper does not state the standardizer for d, an SE or CI for d, or an SE or CI for the adjusted mean difference. No unadjusted SD is inserted into this adjusted record. The paper reports both analyses for the same outcome and sample; they must not be treated as independent estimates. Retaining the prose is a source-specific transcription decision, not a claim that the paper's conflicting adjusted labels have been resolved. The contradictory table cells are quoted separately with no structured numeric fields assigned to them.

not_extracted.reason: Self-reported confirmation of condition assignment, not a creativity or diversity score on task output. See PDF p. 4 (printed p. 98), Section 3.2.

not_extracted.what: S1: baseline fork creativity and within-condition pre-test/post-test changes
not_extracted.reason: The fork output was produced before assignment and AI access. Time and task order were fixed, so this is not a randomized-order crossover and the baseline cannot be coded as after_ai. The methods mention paired tests, but no paired-test statistics are printed. See PDF p. 4 (printed p. 98), Sections 3.1-3.2; PDF p. 5 (printed p. 99), Section 3.4 and Table 1; PDF p. 6 (printed p. 100), Table 2 and Figure 1.

not_extracted.reason: The direct effect controls for post-test ideation, a post-treatment mediator, and is excluded under extraction rule 5. The eligible total ANCOVA contrast is recorded separately. See PDF p. 6 (printed p. 100), Section 4 and Table 3, Creativity Rating outcome, Condition row.

not_extracted.reason: Mediation and mediator-path estimates are excluded, even though creativity is the dependent variable. See PDF p. 5 (printed p. 99), Section 3.4; PDF p. 6 (printed p. 100), Section 4 and Table 3.

not_extracted.what: S1: condition-by-CSE interactions, conditional indirect effects, index of moderated mediation, and high-minus-low conditional indirect-effect difference
not_extracted.reason: Moderation and conditional mediation analyses, not full-sample total treatment contrasts; Figure 2 additionally concerns self-reported ideation. See PDF p. 6 (printed p. 100), Section 4 and Table 3; PDF p. 7 (printed p. 101), Table 3 note and Figure 2.

not_extracted.what: S1: combined-arm descriptives, non-treatment correlations, model-fit statistics, and covariate coefficients
not_extracted.reason: These are not AI-versus-comparison contrasts. Table 1's correlation between randomized condition and post-test creativity is retained in the unadjusted estimate; baseline and other correlations are excluded. Overall model fit and non-condition path coefficients do not measure the randomized contrast. See PDF p. 5 (printed p. 99), Table 1 and Section 4; PDF p. 6 (printed p. 100), Section 4 and Table 3.

open_items: Adjusted arm labels remain contradictory: the Section 4 prose assigns 3.19 [3.15, 3.24] to Human-AI and 2.99 [2.95, 3.04] to Human-Search, while Table 2 assigns them to the opposite arms. The ANCOVA record explicitly transcribes the prose. No corrected labels or underlying adjusted-results output are supplied in the paper, so the source conflict remains unresolved (PDF p. 5 [printed p. 99], Section 4; PDF p. 6 [printed p. 100], Table 2).

The paper reports recruitment and exclusions but not initial randomized counts separately, or arm-specific exclusions. Study and arm n_randomized remain null; analyzed counts come from the stated final sample (PDF p. 4, Section 3.1).

Exact scoring model/version, composite scale, and aggregation of individual uses into a participant score are unspecified (PDF pp. 4-5, Section 3.3). No separate output-scored novelty, usefulness, fluency, or divergence outcome is reported.
The standardizer for the printed Cohen's d and its uncertainty are not stated; no SE or confidence interval for the adjusted mean difference is printed (PDF p. 5, Sections 3.4 and 4).

GPT-4o is named, but its release year, exact model snapshot, and the chatbot system prompt are not given. The AI-tool year is therefore null rather than inferred from external information (PDF p. 4, Section 3.2).
Table 1 prints significance asterisks without its own legend. The unadjusted correlation is transcribed, but its numerical p-value is left null rather than importing the separate Table 3 legend.
